about: Who may sign feedback on this site: the open invitations (only the SHA-256 of each code, so a code cannot be read back from here) and the enrolled keys (a handle, a role and the key's fingerprints; never a name unless the person agreed). Kept by conductor@php.newsroom with admin/build/invite.py; the brief is admin/content/briefs/2026-10-22__brief__feedback-keys-and-review.md.
roles: The editor: his feedback and reviews come first, and the review queue is his
A member of the team that runs the site
A power user: reads what is new when asked, and says what works
